Interface AgentSession

All Known Implementing Classes:
FightLearnSession, FightSession, HeadlessSession, ReplicaTrainer, SparLearnSession, SparSession, Trainer, TrainingSession
interface AgentSession
Something SwordAI is doing in the world from a command until it is stopped: training, a fight with the network playing the user's character, or sparring against it. One runs at a time, and everything here is called on the client thread.
